controller.title: MIDI controller
controller.note: drawn by this manual; it stands for yours

areas.title: The gear (MOD UI)
areas.text: MOD UI puts this gear above every plugin. It opens the **settings page**, the same one that **Settings** opens.

areas.title: Settings
areas.text: Opens the settings page: where you link each footswitch and knob to a control, name the footswitches, set the volts of each knob and assign the pop-up slots.

links.label: Setting it up on the device

areas.title: A — Display
areas.text: Says **which control was used last** and what it did: the name of the footswitch and `ON` or `OFF`, or `Pot 3` and its percentage. It stays on, and lights up for a moment each time a control is used. On a device with no screen for plugin pop-ups, such as the **MOD Duo**, this is how you see a message.

areas.title: C — Name of footswitch {n}
areas.text: Tap and type a name (up to 15 characters): it is the text the **pop-up** and the display show for this footswitch.

areas.title: B — Footswitch {n}
areas.text: A disc in a colour of its own: **lit while the footswitch is on**, and mirrored on its CV output (0 V / 10 V). The one used last is outlined. It only shows: a tap on it does nothing, the control is the one you assigned.

areas.title: D — Potentiometer {n}
areas.text: The position of the knob (0 to 100%) as a meter, and the CV range (**Minimum** to **Maximum**, in volts) its 0 to 10 V output is scaled into. The one used last is outlined. To change the range, open the settings.

areas.title: {title}
areas.text: The CV output of a footswitch: **10 V** while it is on, **0 V** while it is off. Route it to any CV-addressable parameter of another plugin (**Manage CV ports** in MOD UI).

areas.title: {title}
areas.text: The CV output of a potentiometer: its position, scaled between **Minimum** and **Maximum** volts.

areas.title: Footswitch {n} of your controller
areas.text: This box is **not part of Gossiper**: it stands for your MIDI foot controller (or any device control assigned to the plugin). Press a button as the real one would: the plugin turns the message into the display, the disc and the CV output.

areas.title: Knob P{n} of your controller
areas.text: Not part of Gossiper: a knob or expression pedal of your controller. Its position goes out as the CV of **Pot {n}**, between Minimum and Maximum volts.

areas.title: Close
areas.text: Goes back to the pedalboard.

areas.title: Pages
areas.text: The page never scrolls up and down: what does not fit goes on another page to the right. The **arrows** and the **dots** change the page, and on a touch screen you can also **swipe**.

areas.title: Last control used
areas.text: The same as the display of the pedal: the control that was used last.

areas.title: Name of footswitch {n}
areas.text: The name the pop-up and the display show for this footswitch. Up to 15 letters, digits, spaces and `+ - : _ .`.

areas.title: Assign footswitch
areas.text: Tap **Assign** and choose which control drives this footswitch: a **MIDI** message from your foot controller, a footswitch of the device, a CV signal. The button shows a check mark once it is assigned.

links.label: Setting it up on the device

areas.title: Assign potentiometer
areas.text: Link a knob or an expression pedal to this row. Its position goes out as a CV signal between Min and Max, and the pop-up shows its percentage once you stop moving it.

areas.title: Min / Max of pot (volts)
areas.text: The CV range of the potentiometer, from 0 to 10 V: its 0% goes out as **Min** and its 100% as **Max**. Set Min higher than Max to turn the knob into an inverted control.

areas.title: Assign min / max
areas.text: Assigns the minimum or the maximum to another control of the device, so the range itself can be played.

areas.title: Potentiometer {n}
areas.text: A row per knob: the position as a meter and a percentage, the control assigned to it and its voltage range.

areas.title: Pop-up slot ({title})
areas.text: Decides **where** a pop-up shows. MOD devices only show a pop-up for a plugin whose parameter is linked to a control that is **visible on the screen**: link each slot to a page (and a knob or footswitch of it) you play from. Up to four. The MOD Duo cannot show pop-ups, so there these tiles are disabled.

links.label: How the pop-up decides when to appear

areas.title: Saved presets
areas.text: Your own presets of the plugin.

areas.title: Control {n}
areas.text: One row for each control that Gossiper receives.

tours.title: See what a controller does
tours.summary: Press and turn a controller: the display, the discs and the CV follow.

steps.title: What Gossiper is for
steps.text: A MIDI foot controller can send messages but often has **no LED** to say whether a patch is on and **no screen** for a knob. Gossiper turns what it receives into a display, a disc, a CV signal and, on a device with a screen, a pop-up. The box under the plugin is **your controller** (drawn by this manual).

steps.title: Press a footswitch
steps.text: Press footswitch **2** of the controller. The display says **Footswitch 2** and **ON**, its disc lights up, and `CV Foot - Out 2` goes to 10 V.

steps.title: Press another
steps.text: Footswitch **5**: the display now talks about it, and the one used last is outlined. The two stay on until they are turned off.

steps.title: Turn a knob
steps.text: Turn knob **P3** to about two thirds. The display says **Pot 3** and **63%**, the meter fills and the CV output of the pot follows, scaled between Minimum and Maximum volts.

steps.title: Turn it off
steps.text: Press footswitch **2** again: **Footswitch 2 — OFF**, the disc goes dark and its output goes back to 0 V.

tours.title: Name your footswitches
tours.summary: The name is what the pop-up and the display say.

steps.title: Tap a name
steps.text: Tap the name under a disc and type. This is the text the **pop-up** and the display show for that footswitch (up to 15 characters).

steps.title: Another one
steps.text: Name the others the same way: letters, digits, spaces and `+ - : _ .`; anything else becomes `_`.

steps.title: Use it
steps.text: Press footswitch **1** of the controller: the display, and the pop-up on a device with a screen, say **Verse** and **ON**. The names are saved with the pedalboard.

tours.title: Scale a knob in volts
tours.summary: Choose the CV range of a potentiometer.

steps.title: Open the settings page
steps.text: Tap **Settings** (or the gear above the plugin).

steps.title: The potentiometers
steps.text: One row for each knob, with its **Min** and **Max** in volts. If the page has more than one, the arrows of the top bar take you to this one.

steps.title: Minimum
steps.text: Pot 1 goes out as a CV signal between Min and Max. Set **Min** to 2 V: the knob at 0% sends 2 V.

steps.title: Maximum
steps.text: And **Max** to 8 V: the knob at 100% sends 8 V. Anything between scales in a straight line.

steps.title: On the pedalboard
steps.text: The range is shown under the meter of the pot: **2.00 - 8.00 V**.

tours.title: Connect your controller
tours.summary: Assign a footswitch and a pop-up slot, step by step.

steps.title: Open the settings page
steps.text: Tap **Settings**. Each panel starts with **Hardware assignment**: the step where you choose which control drives that parameter.

steps.title: Assign the control
steps.text: In **Footswitches**, tap **Assign** next to *Footswitch 1*. MOD UI opens its own assignment dialog (drawn here in a simplified way): choose **MIDI**, send the message from your controller, and save.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: The button shows a check mark once it is assigned. Repeat for as many footswitches and knobs as you feed in.

steps.title: Assign a pop-up slot
steps.text: Do the same for one of the four **Screen pop-ups** slots: it decides *where* the pop-up will show. Pick a page of the device, and a knob or footswitch of it (B or C on a Dwarf): while that page is on the screen, that is where the pop-up appears.

steps.title: Press the button
steps.text: Now press the button on your controller: its name pops up on the device screen, the disc lights up on the plugin and the CV output goes to 10 V. (Here, press it on the box.)

steps.title: No pop-up?
steps.text: A pop-up only appears while the control you assigned to a slot is **visible on the device screen**. Without it, the display of the plugin and the CV outputs keep working: on a MOD Duo (no screen for pop-ups) the display is the feedback.
